You are shown a snapshot of US macroeconomic and market data as it was known at the end of one month between 2007 and 2026.

Estimate which month the snapshot describes. Use only the figures supplied plus your general knowledge of economic history.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"year": yyyy, "month": m, "confidence": c, "cues": ["...", "..."]}
Rules: year is an integer from 2007 to 2026; month is an integer from 1 to 12; c in [0, 1] is your confidence that the guess is within 6 months of the truth; 1 to 3 short cues citing the inputs.
text:
This looks like 2021, when industrial production, headline CPI and core CPI were all very high relative to the prior 36 months. The unemployment rate was falling sharply over 12 months (-3), which fits recovery from the pandemic. The policy rate was at -1.0 z, still near zero, with a 3m change of +0.5. The dollar was weak (-2.5). The 10-year yield was up strongly over 12 months (+1.5).

That points to mid-to-late 2021. Industrial production at +3.0 on a 12-month change fits the spring-to-autumn 2021 rebound. The equity-bond correlation at +3.0 is odd for 2021, though. The correlation was positive in 2022, but the policy rate was rising sharply then, so this doesn't fit 2022.

Treasury 6m returns of -1.5 fit the period from early 2021 into mid-2021. The 12m change in unemployment of -3 means unemployment fell a lot, which fits April 2021 (from 14.7%) less well than a date later in 2021. The 36-month window by then includes 2020 data, so the z-score of the unemployment level would be around 0 only at a later date.

The 12m change in the 2y yield is +0.5 and in the policy rate is +0.5. Headline CPI 3m change at +3 suggests rapid acceleration. The 3m changes in the 10y (+0.5) and in the 2y (+0.5) are mild. Gold at +1.5 for the month and the VIX at -0.5 fit October 2021, when gold rose and the 2y yield began to climb. The spread (10y minus 2y) at +2.5 fits the steep curve in 2021. Also in October 2021 the dollar's 12-month change was still negative-ish, and Baa spreads were tight.

Overall, October 2021 looks like the best fit, with the other months of late 2021 close behind.
